title: 29 March 1965: Filming: Help!
content:
Following their final Thank Your Lucky Stars appearance in Birmingham the previous day, The Beatles began their first full week of filming Help! at Twickenham Film Studios.

During the week The Beatles worked on a number of sequences including the laboratory and railway station scenes.

Page last updated: 15 May 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2019: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ueno Gakuen Hall, Hiroshima
  • 2012: Paul McCartney live: Royal Albert Hall, London
  • 2003: Paul McCartney live: Palau Sant Jordi, Barcelona
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Kingdome, Seattle
  • 1982: Single release: Ebony And Ivory by Paul McCartney and Stevie Wonder
  • 1974: John Lennon and Paul McCartney meet in Santa Monica
  • 1972: Recording: Mary Had A Little Lamb by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Monkberry Moon Delight by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: Television: Ringo Starr on Frost On Sunday
  • 1970: John Lennon addresses The Festival Of Life in London
  • 1969: Recording: I Remember Jeep by George Harrison
  • 1967: Recording: Good Morning Good Morning, Being For The Benefit Of Mr Kite!, With A Little Help From My Friends
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Odeon Cinema, Lewisham
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Odd Spot Club, Liverpool
